scope: Real, exclusively bound PM8150B PDPHY disable control and a revocable control-generation lease; this is not a complete APSD gate, physical-attach epoch, voltage measurement or USB budget authority

probe.driver: existing qcom,pmic-typec platform driver, exclusive binding of actual native Type-C device
requires: module parameter samurai_5v_only=true and DT boolean realme,pd5v-only
actual OF machine realme,samurai and device compatible qcom,pm8150b-typec
no connector or other child node
vdd-pdphy-supply phandle identical to actual native USB2 PHY vdda33-supply
probe.power: probe only obtains regulator_get handle: zero enable/PD IO. First acquire may regulator_enable only after stable true off/vSafe0V, then fresh post-enable off recheck before PD IO/writes. Retain successful reference, no voltage/load change or shared-rail power-cycle
probe.producer_exclusion: special branch returns before port_probe, pdphy_probe, TCPM registration, port_start and pdphy_start; no PD IRQ handler/reset_work/PD TX callback exists in this branch
probe.normal_default: original normal qcom probe tail and remove tail preserved byte-for-byte; newly registered PM/shutdown callbacks return no-op when pd5v is absent
probe.native_DTB_current: still disabled and missing vdd-pdphy-supply; provided DTS fragment is design-only and remains disabled

first_acquire.requires_explicit_real_client: non-null cancel_join and empty lease; only actual bound device lookup can acquire externally
first_acquire.module_ref: try_module_get before any I/O/write; kref and module reference retained for a successful lease
first_acquire.physical_off: existing exact seven-field plugin/VBUS/CC/state off predicates AND Type-C SM_STATUS vSafe0V bit6=1, vSafe5V bit5=0; two identical status sets separated by at least 500ms; negative reads remain unknown
first_acquire.unchanged_policy: 0x1544 must equal 0x02 (already sink-only; no role write). 0x1362 bits6,5,2 must all be 0 and bit3 1 (HVDCP AUTH/AUTO/ENABLE disabled; no QC write)
first_acquire.known_control_values: reject bits outside BIST 0x8f, TX 0x7f, FILTER 0x21, EN 0x01
first_acquire.power_takeover: before regulator_enable, two fresh identical status-only observations and at least 500ms stable off/vSafe0V. Probe never powers an online PD block. Enable errno or changed off state after enable is terminal for the binding, zero PD writes and no retry; successful supply ref remains held until cleanup
first_acquire.each_write: fresh pre-read of all status/control (250ms maximum sampled read duration), exact stable status and off check; direct readback=0; full post-read and same physical off/policy status
first_acquire.failure: before any write: return actual error or EAGAIN without permission. Once any write attempted: retain stage/write/readback/post error and terminal error for this binding; no automatic continuation, retry, PD enable/reset or old-state restore
first_acquire.engineering_limits: 500ms stability/250ms freshness are conservative software choices, not OEM timing requirements; electrical detach-to-write is not atomic and a post-read race is a failure, not a successful off transaction

lease.validate: samurai_pd5v_validate(lease): unique active lease object, live binding/control generation, no error/block, fresh real register verification; negative return obliges caller to unwind
lease.release: samurai_pd5v_release(lease): drops own lease references; disabled hardware is not re-enabled
lease.success_proves: the explicitly controlled PD block was disabled after a witnessed real detach/vSafe0V; currently retained disabled and inherited sink-only/QC-off policy reverified
does_not_prove: VBUS voltage exactly 5V or arbitrary adapter compliance
UPower Charging or a screen icon

lifecycle.lookup: short registry mutex only for actual device lookup/kref; no device_lock in runtime acquire, no IO/join under registry lock
lifecycle.system_PM: prepare blocks acquisition and invalidates generation, then client cancel_join outside PD5V mutex; return EBUSY and retain error if client fails to release. complete only reads retained controls; changed/unknown controls remain blocked, no reset or auto rewrite. Waiting first-off remains waiting
lifecycle.runtime_PM: special branch never enables runtime PM or defines a runtime power-off path; its regulator reference stays held. Any future runtime PM integration must first invalidate+join and reverify on resume; it is not silently inherited from TCPM
lifecycle.remove_shutdown: remove withdraws real binding, marks removed, invalidates and calls join; references keep object/rail alive until actual lease release. Shutdown quiesces without re-enabling or writing PD. No lease may survive a successful join
lifecycle.trusted_client_contract: cancel_join must synchronously finish and release its lease and must not call a future acquire while blocked; failure revokes permission and returns/logs EBUSY, not fake completion. No cancel/join under TCPM/IRQ/PD5V component locks
lifecycle.IRQ: no PD IRQ consumers or reset workers are registered in this mode. No claim is made that historical PMIC latch bytes were cleared or that the chip has no pending interrupt; those cannot create a Linux TX callback here
